code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Read the diagonal color marks from top-left toward bottom-right.
    marks = {}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v:
                marks.setdefault(r-c, v)
    colors = [marks[k] for k in sorted(marks)]
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    return [[colors[(r+c)%len(colors)] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(code)
